scope: Authorized, independent human approve/reject record bound to exact tone release evidence
validated_behaviors: Evidence bundle integrity and readiness are recomputed before accepting a decision.
The decision binds exact bundle and approver-registry SHA-256 values.
Approvers must be active, in their validity window and hold tone:release:approve.
An annotation reviewer cannot approve the same release bundle.
Approval requires holdout, budget-policy and rollback acknowledgements.
A rejection may preserve an incomplete bundle but can never become an approval candidate.
known_boundary: This validates a human decision artifact only. It does not import an admission, authenticate an interactive session, enable publication, change the database or deploy production.
